name: autoUpdater
description:
> Enable apps to automatically update themselves.

Process: Main

**See also: A detailed guide about how to implement updates in your application.**

`autoUpdater` is an EventEmitter.

### Platform Notices

Currently, only macOS and Windows are supported. There is no built-in support for auto-update

members.name: setFeedURL
members.desc: Sets the `url` and initialize the auto updater.

members.name: checkForUpdates
members.desc:
Asks the server whether there is an update. You must call `setFeedURL` before using this API.

members.name: quitAndInstall
members.desc:
Restarts the app and installs the update after it has been downloaded. It should only be called after `update-downloaded` has been emitted.

members.name: error
members.desc: Emitted when there is an error while updating.

members.name: checking-for-update
members.desc: Emitted when checking for an available update has started.

members.name: update-available
members.desc: Emitted when there is an available update. The update is downloaded automatically.

members.name: update-not-available
members.desc: Emitted when there is no available update.

members.name: update-downloaded
members.desc:
Emitted when an update has been downloaded.

members.name: before-quit-for-update
members.desc:
This event is emitted after a user calls `quitAndInstall()`.
